summary: Advises using a path listed in COLLECTIONS_PATHS when passing `-p` so Ansible can find the collection. Without `-p`, the install goes to the first COLLECTIONS_PATHS entry, `~/.ansible/collections` by default.
questions: I installed a collection with -p but Ansible can't find it, why?
Which path should I pass to -p when installing collections?
Where does collection install go if I don't specify a path?

answer_card.title: Choose an install path Ansible will search
answer_card.answer_md:
When you use `-p`, pick one of the directories configured in `COLLECTIONS_PATHS`, because that is where Ansible looks for collections. If you install somewhere else, Ansible won't find it.

Without `-p`, `ansible-galaxy collection install` uses the first path in `COLLECTIONS_PATHS`, which defaults to `~/.ansible/collections`.
